title: Quick British Bangers Pan-Fried Sausage and Mashed Potatoes
description: A hearty British-style dish featuring pan-fried sausages and mashed potatoes, perfect for a quick and comforting meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the potatoes until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sausages to the skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Drain the cooked potatoes and return them to the pot.
Add the milk, salt, and black pepper to the potatoes and mash until smooth.
Stir in the grated cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve the sausages on top of the mashed potatoes, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
